description: This file is a detailed view script for the EmailMarketing module in SuiteCRM, responsible for rendering the email marketing detail page, initializing variables, handling request parameters, and integrating related components such as prospect lists, campaign info, and subpanels.

classes.name: javascript
classes.description: Handles client-side form validation and script generation for the detail view.

classes.name: SubPanelTiles
classes.description: Manages display and exclusion of subpanels related to the EmailMarketing record.

methods.name: get_set_focus_js
methods.description: Returns JavaScript code to set focus when the form loads.

methods.name: get_bean_select_array
methods.description: Retrieves an array of bean options for select input elements, e.g., email templates.

methods.name: getClassicModuleTitle
methods.description: Generates the standard module title for the page, including links to related entities.

methods.name: get_campaign_mailboxes
methods.description: Fetches mailboxes related to the campaign for display in the email marketing detail view.
